p3_b3.ocr: In a separate analysis of drug adherence patterns, the first table lists patterns with corresponding data for students (n=60) and villagers (n=60): 17 students, or 28.3%, stop drugs when symptoms disappear, while 24 villagers, or 40.0%, do the same. Eight students (13.3%) stop when tired of the drug, compared to 11 villagers (18.3%).

p3_b4.ocr: Ten students (16.7%) take some and leave the rest, while 8 villagers (13.3%) follow this pattern. Additionally, 25 students (41.7%) take all drugs even when symptoms disappear, versus 10 villagers (16.7%). Lastly, no students (0.0%) do not complete the dose due to financial constraint, while 7 villagers (11.7%) report this issue.
